profile.headline: CEO/Software Developer at ROTECHUSA.
profile.summary:
iOS Native Mobile Application Developer, US Navy Veteran, passionate about learning new things in life, business, and technology.

 “Some people can read ‘War and Peace’ and come away thinking it’s a simple adventure story. Others can read the ingredients on a chewing gum wrapper and unlock the secrets of the universe.” - Unknown

positions.title: Founder/Software Developer at ROTECHUSA
positions.description: Specializing in digital displays, infotainment systems, and power distribution modules for automotive startups, motorsports, and concept vehicle developers.

positions.title: CEO/Founder
positions.description:
iOS Native Mobile Application Developer

Developed over 55 iOS Mobile Applications 24 of which are my own
AppStore: https://itunes.apple.com/us/developer/eric-rosas/id895308287?mt=8
My GitHub Developer Account: https://github.com/EmpireAppDesignz?tab=repositories
Developed/updated various app and web projects for clients that included:
• AWS/EC2 integration
• IoT projects for controlling functions in a home or vehicle
• Bluetooth & WIFI Integration
• Mobile ECommerce
• Stripe/PayPal payment integration
• API/RESTful Implementation
Interview with Mapbox for an iOS Mobile Application I developed using their API:
https://blog.mapbox.com/2020-phantom-motorcycle-460-hp-280-lb-ft-torque-in-dash- navigation-1b64254c6fc4

positions.title: CEO/Founder
positions.description: Providing tools to bridge the gap between recruiters and hiring managers and re-imagining how organizations can think about growth, with talent and teamwork at the center.

positions.title: Claims Representative
positions.description: Assist individuals in establishing entitlement to benefits under Social Security programs. Have contact with the public either in face-to-face interviews or by telephone. These contacts will allow me to obtain, clarify and verify information which will be used to analyze claims and make decisions regarding entitlement to disability benefits.

positions.title: Recruiter
positions.description: Recruits individuals into the U.S. Navy and Naval Reserve. Possesses expertise in recruiting techniques and knowledge of recruiting textbooks and Navy enlistment programs and policies. Communicates and relates effectively with prospects, groups and the community. Possesses a basic knowledge of classification techniques.
